properties.name: Oakland Pier
properties.geometry_method: Traced by eye from USGS Oakland West 1:24,000 (1949) (1 hand-read points). The west end of the mole's tracks, at the ferry slips.

sources.note: "eleven tracks running the full length of the Mole"; 15 shed tracks, "7 for electric suburban business".

properties.name: Sixteenth Street Station
properties.geometry_method: At today's corner of 16th Street and Wood Street; checked on USGS Oakland West 1:24,000 (1949).

sources.note: The suburban tracks are "elevated to the level of the second floor".

properties.notes: Drawn at today's corner of 16th and Wood Streets, beside the station building.

properties.name: Northbrae
properties.geometry_method: At today's corner of Sutter Street and Hopkins Street; checked on USGS Richmond 1:24,000 (1949).

sources.note: "Northbrae station, located at the intersection of Sutter and Hopkins Streets"

properties.name: Thousand Oaks
properties.geometry_method: At today's corner of Solano Avenue and Colusa Avenue; checked on USGS Richmond 1:24,000 (1949).

sources.note: "a terminus at Thousand Oaks Station at Colusa Street and Solano Avenue"
